description: Draft policy-object propositions for review; no nation-level labels and no implied correct geopolitical position.
coding_rule: Code the explicit position attributable to the speaker on the named proposition. A topic mention, quotation, third-party statement or political assumption does not establish endorsement.

propositions.proposition: The speaker explicitly supports respect for Ukraine's sovereignty and territorial integrity.
propositions.scope: UN speech passages concerning Ukraine's territorial integrity; support must be in the speaker's own voice.
propositions.exclusion_rule: Naming Ukraine, referencing a negotiation, or quoting another delegation does not alone establish a position.

propositions.proposition: The speaker explicitly opposes the use of military force against Ukraine in violation of the UN Charter.
propositions.scope: Statements about the use of force in Ukraine and its consistency with the Charter; record legal qualifications.
propositions.exclusion_rule: General support for peace or concern over war does not alone indicate support for this proposition.

propositions.target: United States economic embargo against Cuba
propositions.proposition: The speaker explicitly supports ending the United States economic embargo against Cuba.
propositions.scope: Expressed position on the named US embargo; distinguish wider sanctions discussion from Cuba-specific measures.
propositions.exclusion_rule: Mentioning Cuba or sanctions without linking the actual policy object is insufficient.

propositions.proposition: The speaker explicitly opposes extraterritorial enforcement of Cuba-related economic restrictions.
propositions.scope: Positions on Cuba-related secondary, financial, trade or extraterritorial restrictions; verify the specific object.
propositions.exclusion_rule: General objections to unilateral sanctions do not establish a Cuba-specific stance.

propositions.target: Legally binding international AI governance obligations
propositions.proposition: The speaker explicitly supports legally binding international obligations governing artificial intelligence.
propositions.scope: Formal international AI governance obligations as distinct from voluntary norms, declarations and capacity-building.
propositions.exclusion_rule: Support for AI cooperation, UN discussion or AI capacity-building is not endorsement of binding rules.

propositions.proposition: The speaker explicitly supports legally binding international limits on autonomous weapons systems.
propositions.scope: Statements specifying binding limits on military autonomous weapons; distinguish development controls from a categorical ban.
propositions.exclusion_rule: Generic concern about military AI or endorsement of nonbinding principles does not establish support.
